title: Cloud Security: occurrence fees
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for occurrence fees.

## Basis

Setup fee: One-time fee for a newly activated holding; USD decimal.

On-demand termination fee: Fee for terminating an on-demand holding, excluding accrued usage and commitment liability; USD decimal.

Resumption fee: Fee for restoring a suspended holding; USD decimal.

Bank-return fee: Fee per bank-confirmed returned remittance; USD decimal.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Setup fee | On-demand termination fee | Resumption fee | Bank-return fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Tier comparison

The listed occurrence fees bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
